title: Stateless player and runtime boundary (step 7 offline)
summary: Dev7r1: deterministic player text integration, private memory, explicit runtime profiles, provider codecs and isolated transport. Seeded inbox delivery. Live gate still open.
invariants: Fixed SYSTEM header plus own designer prompt, then RULES, MAP, STATE, LAST RESULTS, PLAYER LIST, INBOX, MEMORY, TASK. All text is detached. No referee object or legal order hints.
Raw public results since last successful call are quoted. Numeric list only in press, inbox follows existing round barrier. Own private memory only.

One optional MEMORY block replaces own notes; absent retains, empty clears; 8000 UTF-8 code points capped and logged. Only complete phase-appropriate SEND or ORDERS blocks have effects. Bad response or timeout atomic; no repair of order bytes. Visible text outside blocks logged, not hidden reasoning.

Every call is fresh; same immutable explicit provider profile for all powers. Exact model, effort, max output and timeout required, no default or alias. Supported low/medium/high map to Haiku output_config.effort or Sol reasoning.effort; no claim of equal compute. Haiku adaptive thinking; Sol store=false, no previous_response_id. No sampling controls or reasoning effort none.
Reject wrong model, incomplete response, refusal, malformed JSON and absent or invalid usage. Visible text of rejected decodable responses remains in operator audit; reasoning blocks excluded.

Transport accepts provider/body/timeout and yields status/HTTP/body. Curl uses fixed HTTPS endpoints, short-lived Secret Broker lease, stdin config, private request/response scratch, no secrets in argv or request, outer deadline, no retries. Offline fake curl tested; actual live transport not executed.

Canonical replay journal unchanged; separate operator journal records game/seed/phase/power/round/profile, SHA512 prompt digest, full system/user/visible output, status, token usage, elapsed and memory cuts. Keep operator log private. SHA512 via estate crypto v0.8.3 native path, not step-8 prompt seal.
Do not treat fixture IDs or budgets as authorized. data/engine-profile.example fails closed. Actual Haiku game year must await Architect pins and credentials.
New games use DIPLOG|3 seeded inbox sender grouping to remove fixed seat rank. Historical formats retained for replay.
procedure: Run sh tests/run.sh under exact ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 and pinned estate dependencies.
Review README and evidence/PLAYER-QUALIFICATION.md and INBOX-ORDER-QUALIFICATION.md; latest package oorexx_diplomacy_v0.1-dev7r1.

Operator-only tools/live.rex requires explicit pinned profile, rules text, seven designer prompt files, game ID, seed and fresh journal; provision Secret Broker and private operator directory, verify all statuses. No automatic authorization to spend.

additional_offline_cli_probe.scope: SecretBroker v0.2 with published Alchemy Objects v0.8 and fake curl; declared v0.7 dependency not recovered; no real network
